title: Normalization and ddPCR Setup
author: Opentrons
materials: (User) Ensure that all necessary reagents are loaded with appropriate volumes.
Samples are individually transferred to Normalization Plate.

steps.title: Load reagents and files
steps.instruction: Ensure all required reagents are loaded with the appropriate volumes, upload the CSV file (must contain a header row with columns Well, Sample Volume (µL), Dilutent Volume (µL)), and place the source plate in deck slot 4 and the normalization plate in deck slot 5.

steps.title: Add diluent to normalization plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the diluent volume specified in the CSV Dilutent Volume column to each corresponding well of the normalization plate (deck slot 5).

steps.title: Transfer samples to normalization plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample volume specified in the CSV Sample Volume column from the source plate (deck slot 4) to the matching well of the normalization plate.

steps.title: Create reaction mix (optional)
steps.instruction: If the ‘Automate Reaction Mix Creation’ option is selected, prepare the reaction mix according to the experiment’s formulation.

steps.title: Dispense reaction mix to destination
steps.instruction: Dispense 18 µL of the prepared reaction mix into every well of each destination plate.

steps.title: Add normalized sample replicates
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of the normalized sample from each well of the normalization plate to the destination wells containing reaction mix, creating the number of replicates specified (e.g., for 3 replicates, dispense to three consecutive wells such as A1, B1, C1 for source A1).
